outcome: Pattern of presentation of placenta previa
Management outcome of pregnancies complicated by placenta previa
cohort: 47 patients with placenta previa out of 5124 deliveries at Olabisi Onabanjo University Teaching Hospital, Sagamu, Ogun State, Nigeria between January 1st, 2013 and December 31st, 2017
finding: The prevalence of placenta previa was 0.92%, with postpartum hemorrhage being the most common complication (23.8%), and a perinatal mortality rate of 13.5%.
